method: shallow clone plus source/schema inspection; README alone was not used

repositories.name: alibaba/SmartResume
repositories.useful_pattern: layout/read-order text with line ranges, then separate basic/work/education structured extraction and blank missing values
repositories.job_radar_decision: adopt separation and provenance ranges; do not copy its unpublished internal PDF/OCR path or model prompts

repositories.name: infiniflow/ragflow
repositories.useful_pattern: native PDF cells plus OCR only where native text is absent, then layout/order processing
repositories.job_radar_decision: adopt selective native/OCR source selection; reject blind overlap fusion after it regressed grouping

repositories.name: hiroi-sora/GapTree_Sort_Algorithm
repositories.useful_pattern: recursive whitespace-gap tree over text bounding boxes to reconstruct columns and reading order
repositories.job_radar_decision: adopt only for OCR Resume pages where multi-column ordering is needed; reject as global default because it split a reliable native Resume

repositories.name: PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
source_patterns_read: PP-StructureV3 pipeline source and official docs
repositories.useful_pattern: layout-labelled regions, OCR, table/formula components and ordered parsing result
repositories.job_radar_decision: benchmark adapter only; reject default due measured runtime/resource/dependency cost

repositories.name: datalab-to/surya
repositories.license: Apache-2.0 code; modified AI Pubs OpenRAIL-M model weights
repositories.useful_pattern: unified OCR/layout/reading-order output backed by a document VLM
repositories.job_radar_decision: reject default because local runtime is not self-contained and model-license obligations materially change the product boundary

repositories.name: docling-project/docling
repositories.useful_pattern: one document IR with typed layout items, bbox/page provenance and PDF-aware OCR modes
repositories.job_radar_decision: adopt representation ideas in DocumentBlock v1; retain Docling as reference, not runtime dependency
